**Finding 1 (high, correctness — configured models omitted from audit dispatches):** Fixed both production dispatch sites. `completion_dispatch._dispatch_via_executor` (completion_dispatch.py:774) and the dispatch closure built by `sufficiency_auditor._production_sufficiency_dispatch` (sufficiency_auditor.py:920) now set `model=resolve_goal_audit_model(plan_dir)` on their `DispatchTask`s. The new `resolve_goal_audit_model` helper in `config/resolvers.py` resolves the goal_auditor-role model first and mirrors `resolve_role`'s goal_auditor→auditor fall-through — but only when no layer names an explicit `roles.goal_auditor`, because when one is configured the goal-audit agent may be a different vendor than the auditor and reusing the auditor's model id would hand one vendor's model string to another vendor's CLI. Six regression tests cover set/unset/fall-through/no-fall-through on both paths; the sufficiency tests capture the real builder at import time since the conftest paid-auditor guard patches that symbol per-test (the tests stay fully offline — `get_executor` is monkeypatched).

**Finding 2 (medium, architecture — silent deviation from the locked `roles.*.model` contract):** Implemented the plan-locked shape with backward compatibility rather than amending the plan. `RolesConfig` entries now accept either a plain agent-name string (pre-F012 shape, unchanged) or a new `RoleSpec` object (`{"name": "codex", "model": "gpt-5.2-codex"}`,
